title: Dubai Police offers jobs to family of mother who died after giving birth to twins
summary: Dubai: Dubai Police has offered jobs to the husband and younger sister of a former employee who died following the birth of her twin sons, extending nearly five decades of support to a family whose ties with the force span three generations. Marwa Ahmed Al Amin Bakhit, 36, died on September 23, 2026, after giving birth to her sons, Fahd and Fahed, at a hospital in Ajman. Her death left her husband, Othman Ahmed Mohammed Al Makki, facing life with two newborns who had lost their mother at birth, while the family lost its principal breadwinner.
